title: Mediterranean Crumble
description: A unique dessert combining the crunch of a crumble topping with the flavors of the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: mediterranean
ingredients.notes: A mix of olives, feta, and sun-dried tomatoes

ingredients.name: crumble
ingredients.notes: A combination of almond flour, coconut sugar, and olive oil

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the Mediterranean mix and yogurt.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the crumble ingredients until well combined.
Top the Mediterranean mixture with the crumble mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crumble is golden brown.
